journey.name: link contact after resume
journey.description: Requires two disposable Bitkit identities with contact payment sharing enabled. On the second device, save the first identity as a contact and keep Bitkit open. The first device must not already have the second identity saved or linked. No payment is sent. Record the time from saving the contact to Request or Pay becoming available; there is no fixed latency assertion.

actions.action: On the first device, open Contacts and add the second identity by its Pubky key
Save the contact and verify Contact Saved shows the second identity's name
Immediately press the device Home button, wait 5 seconds, then reopen Bitkit
Open the saved contact from Contacts without saving or importing it again
Tap Pay and wait for the result; if Request or Pay is not yet offered, close the payment flow without paying and retry after 5 seconds
Verify Request or Pay becomes available with an enabled Request button; record elapsed time or report a failure if it never becomes available during the run
Tap Request and verify the Payment Request amount screen opens
Close the request flow without sending, return to Contacts and verify the contact appears only once
